title: Hymn and House
author: Tamsin Sterling
blurb: Beatrix Kavanagh, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
